summary: The authors’ retained GEO metadata identifies the registered rebound-IP versus control-IP comparison and names its combined DESeq2 results file. The file returned HTTP 403, and the public-source search found no matching paper, supplement, or repository copy. Gene-level concordance remains unassessed. [GEO access notice](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE317867&targ=all&form=text&view=full)
openIssues: GEO schedules public release for July 1, 2027. When the CSV becomes available, verify the coefficient direction and whether the authors’ enrichment filter limits gene coverage before comparing results.
